lines.text: بیماریها و بهتان درامدن بسخنان بیهوده و یاوه و ارتکاب مردم بهجو و بدگوئی و نوشتن
lines.en: diseases, and the emergence of slander in vain and absurd words, and people committing satire and speaking ill, and writing

lines.text: خطوط مزوره و احراز و تعویذات و هیاکل و بسیاری کذب و اخبار اراجیف و گفتگوی
lines.en: forged documents, and amulets, and talismans, and figures, and much falsehood, and false news, and the conversation of

lines.text: اهل ذمه توام با قشر حکما و فضلا و خلاف علما در مسائل علوم حقیقیه و بیماریها
lines.en: the people of the dhimma, accompanied by the superficiality of philosophers and scholars, and the disagreement of the learned in the issues of the true sciences, and diseases

lines.text: از دمیدگیها و وقوع جنون و حدوث صرع و ام الصبیان و کساد بازارها و زیان
lines.en: from swellings, and the occurrence of madness, and the incidence of epilepsy, and infantile spasms, and the stagnation of markets, and the loss of

lines.text: صناع و پیشه داران (احکام بودن قمر مع ذنب) دلالت کند بر سرگردانی عامه و مجذوب
lines.en: artisans and tradesmen. (The judgments of the Moon being with the Tail) indicates the bewilderment of the common people, and becoming attracted

lines.text: شدن ایشان از خلاف سفلکان و مردم هوائی و بدی حال جاسوسان و گرفتاری ایشان
lines.en: of them from the opposition of the lowly and the people of the air, and the bad condition of spies, and their capture,

lines.text: و در قید افتادن ابلهان و توقف ایشان و حدوث امراض در اطفال و حبالی و وقوع
lines.en: and the falling into bondage of fools, and their stopping, and the incidence of diseases in children and pregnant women, and the occurrence of

lines.text: ام الصبیان و گفتگوی عوام الناس و افتادن اراجیف و فساد میوها در وقت و غم و غصه
lines.en: infantile spasms, and the conversation of the common people, and the falling of false rumors, and the corruption of fruits in time, and sorrow and grief,

lines.text: و بدحالی مسافران و شاطران و تفاوت نرخها و افتادن جانوران زهر دار و کثرت درد
lines.en: and the bad condition of travelers and rogues, and the difference in prices, and the falling of venomous animals, and the abundance of pain

lines.text: چشم و دیوزدگی و عفونت ابها و ترس و بیم کودکان و افتادن از بلندیها (تنبیه)
lines.en: of the eye, and demonic possession, and the putrefaction of waters, and the fear and dread of children, and falling from heights. (Warning)

lines.text: ابو معشر بلخی در کتاب مختصر الاسرار اورده که اگر کوکبی با راس یا ذنب باشد و در مقام
lines.en: Abu Ma'shar al-Balkhi in the book Mukhtasar al-Asrar has brought that if a planet is with the Head or the Tail, and in the place of

lines.text: شمس نباشد دلالت کند بر فساد و اعتبا زان بمرور قمر کرده است براس و ذنب در
lines.en: the Sun it is not, it indicates corruption, and the consideration of that is by the passing of the Moon over the Head and the Tail in

lines.text: هر ماه دو مرتبه که تا افتاب در مقابله نباشد خسوف نشود و این سخن محل تامل است
lines.en: every month two times, that until the Sun is in opposition, an eclipse does not happen, and this speech is a place of reflection.

lines.text: اما حق اینستکه اگر افتاب انوقت در مقابل افتد بر مقتضیات راس منجز بنحوست خواهد شد
lines.en: But the truth is this, that if the Sun at that time falls in opposition, upon the requirements of the Head, it will be accomplished with misfortune,

lines.text: و مقتضیات ذنب تاخیر و افسد خواهد بود (تنبیه) هر کوکب که در خانه و شرف خود
lines.en: and the requirements of the Tail will be delay and more corrupt. (Warning) Every planet that is in its own house and exaltation,

lines.text: یا سایر حظوظ و قوی باشد و محاسد راس شود انچه در تاثیرات جیده ان مذکور با
lines.en: or other fortunes, and is strong, and becomes the envier of the Head, that which is mentioned in its good effects, with

lines.text: محمول بر مبالغه و تاکید بود و اگر در هبوط و وبال و مثل ان باشد انچه در تاثیرات ردیه
lines.en: is carried upon exaggeration and emphasis, and if it is in fall and detriment and the like of that, that which is in the bad effects

lines.text: ان تاثیرات بضعف و زبونی مؤدی شود و در محاسده ذنب حکم بر خلاف این بود یعنی
lines.en: of those effects, it leads to weakness and baseness, and in the envying of the Tail, the judgment is contrary to this, meaning

lines.text: اگر کوکبی در خانه و شرف و مثل ان بود انچه در تاثیرات ردیه ان مکتوب شده باشد
lines.en: if a planet is in its house and exaltation and the like of that, that which is written in its bad effects,

lines.text: بضعف و زبونی ادا باید نمود و اگر در وبال و هبوط و امثال ان باشد بمبالغه و تاکید
lines.en: must be performed with weakness and baseness, and if it is in detriment and fall and the likes of that, with exaggeration and emphasis.

lines.text: (فصل هفتم در احکام بودن کواکب مع عقدتین مع کید) جمهور گویند کید
lines.en: (The seventh chapter on the judgments of the planets being with the two nodes with Kayd) The majority say Kayd

lines.text: کوکبیست متوهم که او را سیریست معکوس که در صد و چهل و چهار سال شمسی دوره تمام
lines.en: is an imagined planet, which has a retrograde motion, which in one hundred and forty-four solar years completes a cycle,

lines.text: کند و برجی در دوازده سال و درجه در صد و چهل و شش روز و بعضی گویند کوکب
lines.en: and a sign in twelve years, and a degree in one hundred and forty-six days, and some say a planet

summary.headline: Judgments of the Moon and Kayd
summary.text: Judgments of the Moon with the Tail concern slander, false documents and rumors, disease, market decline, travel, prices, venomous animals, corrupted waters, and other misfortunes. Abu Ma'shar al-Balkhi's Mukhtasar al-Asrar is cited on planets with the lunar Head or Tail, followed by the seventh chapter on planets with the two nodes and Kayd, described as an imagined retrograde planet.
